planets.name: KELT-14 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-14 with a 1.71-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: KELT-14 b was found in 2016 by KELT-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-14. Its orbit and size follow Turner et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname TURNER_ET_AL__2016): disc_year 2016, disc_facility KELT-South, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.71005328, pl_radj 1.743, pl_bmassj 1.284

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
thermal.where: table 2, row WASP-122, the name the catalogue gives KELT-14 b
